profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Abbott
profile.summary: Dedicated Software Engineer specializing in Linux Kernel and Embedded Systems. Experienced Team Leader of embedded C++ projects targeting multiple development platforms.  Specialized experience implementing machine learning algorithms in resource constrained embedded environments.

positions.title: Sr Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Embedded C++ software development for radar detection and countermeasures.

positions.description: C++ Project team lead developing software for multiple different platforms.  Responsible for requirements,  development, and test to ensure the successful delivery of our product.
